planning_notes: Button on D3: model true corresponds to pressed; active_high assumed such that a pressed button drives the input HIGH. If the actual circuit inverts this (e.g., pull-down/active-low), then active_high must be adjusted in the SysML mapping rather than inverting the model value again.
Buzzer on D6 uses tone_output; the SysML model must implement 'press => sound', and 'release => stop after 1 second' using the registered elapsed_ms delta-based timekeeping.
No serial reporting or serial receive requirements were provided.

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer tone output; model will start while button is held and stop 1s after release

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Delta time since previous control step for 1s-after-release timing logic
